Jharkhand : Ranchi men niji chainal ke daphtar pahunchi Simdega Police, to BJP ne diya dharna
Simdega se kangres vidhayak bhushan bara par ek nabalig larki dvara dushkarm ka aarop lagaya gaya hai. iske bad simdega pulis ranchi men ek niji chainal ke daphtar par bari sankhya men tim ke sath ravivar ko pahunch gayi.
